verdict: VOID — instrument could not have detected an effect
reasons_void: A: two of three surfaces are degenerate — numeric (saturated at 1.0) and mixed (constant -1161.0) return one distinct value across 27 replicates, so a 0.0 delta is structural, not empirical.
B: on the one live surface (packing) the paired delta -3.0 is inside the SAME-RUN replicate range of the identical empty artifact (8.00 points, sd 2.61 over 29 re-scorings).

C: the arms did not receive equal search AT THE SCORED LEVEL — 'equal total budget' gave standard 2 iterations at o3 and recursive 1 (it spent the other on o2). Design flaw in the probe, not a finding.
D: artifacts_differ=false on all three hypotheses — the selected artifact never moved from the default in either arm, which by the standing checklist voids the delta by itself.
